messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick question — new hire Sofia added spouse to benefits but spouse is remote in Ireland and Sofia started yesterday. Do we set benefits effective date to the hire date or to the start of the next pay period when payroll sync for IE hasn't run? Also what proof do we require for an international spouse? @Liam (Payroll) can you advise on payroll sync windows and any fields we need set?

Liam (Payroll): We generally align effective date to the hire date if it's within the current pay period, so coverage can be retro'd to that date. Payroll sync runs nightly at 02:00 UTC for all regions. For international spouse docs: translated marriage certificate + apostille if outside UK/EEA. If apostille pending we mark status 'pending docs' and process retro once verified.

Sofia: Thanks — I uploaded the marriage cert PDF to the portal just now (link: https://redwood.example/uploads/sofia-marriage.pdf). No apostille yet, that's in progress. Onboarding noted benefits would be active immediately so I'm hoping we can avoid a gap.

Maya (People Ops): Got the link, thanks. I'll set the enrollment to 'pending docs' for now. If we can confirm hire-date effective, we'll submit a retro adjustment when docs clear.

HR Bot: Enrollment change received from Sofia — status: pending_verification. Reference ID: ENR-202-789. Reminder: upload supporting docs within 30 days to avoid processing delays.

Liam (Payroll): If docs are approved after the pay run, we can process a one-time off-cycle to catch up premiums and employer contributions. For payroll metadata, set country_code = IE and spouse_flag = 1. If you want me to do the manual override, say the word and I'll queue it.

Maya (People Ops): Please go ahead and queue the override but keep it conditional on doc approval. I'll keep the record in 'pending' until apostille uploaded. Steps for clarity:
- Maya: set status 'pending docs' and effective date = hire date (pending)
- Sofia: upload apostille + translated doc when ready
- Liam: run manual override / off-cycle after docs verified
If apostille is delayed >30 days, we accept notarized affidavit as fallback — will confirm with legal.

Sofia: Appreciate it. One more thing — premiums: will deductions be in USD or EUR? I'm on US payroll but spouse lives in Ireland and provider might bill in EUR.

Liam (Payroll): Deductions post to the employee's US payroll in USD. If the benefits vendor bills in EUR, the company handles vendor settlement; the payroll deduction will be USD equivalent on the pay statement. I'll loop in benefits to confirm any vendor-specific work.

Raj (Benefits): Confirming — Redwood bills US payroll in USD for employees on US payroll. If vendor invoices in EUR, we cover vendor in EUR; there is no separate employee expense for currency conversion. We'll reconcile vendor charges centrally.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Action items captured: 1) I set enrollment pending and tentative effective = hire date, 2) Sofia to upload apostille + translation, 3) Liam to queue manual payroll override after doc verification, 4) Raj confirmed USD payroll deductions. Thanks all :thumbsup:

HR Bot: Reminder scheduled — upload required docs by 30 days from enrollment (deadline: 1809959921).

Sofia: I'll upload apostille when it's ready (ETA ~2 weeks). Will follow up here when done.

Maya (People Ops): Great — leave the thread open and ping if anything changes.
